items.Sentence: Secondary-treatment capacity at the Los Alisos WRP is 7.5 MGD and includes screening and aerated lagoons.
Screenings and grit from the Los Alisos WRP influent are hauled to a Class I Landfill.
Secondary-treatment capacity at the Los Alisos WRP is 7.5 MGD and includes screening and aerated lagoons.

A portion of the secondary-treated wastewater receives tertiary treatment, which includes chemical addition, flash mixing, coagulation, flocculation, sedimentation, filtration, and chlorine disinfection.
